I told Hollis in his #central-team thread that the site is Gate 47. Pree first posted Dock 23 in #central-team on Oct 14, then corrected it to Gate 47 the same day. Hollis is a member of #central-team, so he can see both of her messages.

gbrain refused both lookups because this connection isn't tied to any member. So the answer comes straight from #central-team. To make gbrain readable again, the brain owner has to rescope the token on the brain host: `gbrain auth rescope --token <token> --member <member>`.
